headline: Celebrity Fashions submits AGM scrutiny report and voting results
summary: Celebrity Fashions Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a standard corporate compliance filing required by regulatory exchanges. No extraordinary resolutions or corporate actions were highlighted in the announcement. Retail investors holding the stock can note the completion of the annual voting process.
why_it_matters: Standard compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price
